verdict.rationale: The evidence shows official, publicly installable packages for building agentic flows. The mppx SDK is live on npm (0.9.3), and its docs include language-tabbed guides (?lang=node) and an `mppx validate` conformance tool. Stripe also publishes @stripe/link-cli and @stripe/cli on npm, and llms.txt tells agents to install Stripe packages from npm. However, nothing documents first-party server SDKs for the Agentic Commerce Suite surfaces (SPT creation, checkout hooks, catalog import), and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: explicit official multi-language SDK coverage for ACS/SPT APIs, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
